and {{ill|Katori Shrines|ja|香取神社|zh|香取神社|qid=Q11667187}} are not common enough to bother making all the articles but making these lists is good because I think a lot of westerners do not understand the sheer quantity of them[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:07, 24 March 2025 (UTC)}}

'''Kashima Shrine''' (鹿島神社, [[:en:Kyujitai|Kyujitai]]: 鹿嶋神社) is a type of Shinto shrine named "Kashima" dedicated to the deity {{ill|Takemikazuchi|en|Takemikazuchi|qid=Q1502690|qid=Q1502690|lt=Takemikazuchi}}.

There are approximately 600 Kashima Shrines nationwide, concentrated primarily in the {{ill|Tōhoku region|en|Tōhoku region|qid=Q129465|lt=Tōhoku region}} and the {{ill|Kantō region|en|Kantō region|qid=Q132480|lt=Kantō region}}, with the head shrine being {{ill|Kashima Jingū|en|Kashima Shrine|qid=Q706499|lt=Kashima Jingū}} in {{ill|Kashima, Ibaraki|en|Kashima, Ibaraki|qid=Q467471|lt=Kashima, Ibaraki}}, {{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Ibaraki|af|Ibaraki-prefektuur|an|Prefectura d'Ibaraki|ar|إيباراكي (محافظة)|arz|ايباراكى|az|İbaraki Most of these shrines were established by inviting the deity from Kashima Jingū, worshipping the same deity, Takemikazuchi.

Takemikazuchi, together with {{ill|Futsunushi|en|Futsunushi|qid=Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|lt=Futsunushi}} of {{ill|Katori Jingū|en|Katori Shrine|qid=Q372380|lt=Katori Jingū}} ({{ill|Katori, Chiba|en|Katori, Chiba|qid=Q858357|lt=Katori, Chiba}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture}}), was revered by the Imperial court and central aristocracy as the ancestral deity of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|ar|ناكاتومي|de|Nakatomi (Klan)|el|Αδελφότητα Νακατόμι|es|Clan Nakatomi|fa|خاندان ناکاتومی|fr|Clan Nakatomi|it|Clan Nakatomi|ja|中臣氏|ko|나카토미씨|nl|Nakatomi-clan|pl|Nakatomi (ród)|pt|Clã Nakatomi|vi|Gia tộc Nakatomi|zh|中臣氏|qid=Q1198447|lt=Nakatomi clan}} and {{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|qid=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}. Being a god of martial prowess, Takemikazuchi was also worshipped by samurai families ('''Kashima belief''').
